verdict: Service in the focus hours is significantly worse than the baseline on late_share.

evidence: [R] 100% of late trains were already late at Prospect Av (inherited delay). Origins: at or before 59 St: 6, at 36 St: 2, at 45 St: 1. Largest time loss on segment 45 St -> 36 St (median +38s vs schedule).
[R] 94% of headway gaps at the target already existed at Prospect Av.

[N] 100% of late trains were already late at Prospect Av (inherited delay). Origins: at or before 59 St: 5, at 36 St: 5, at 45 St: 1, at 53 St: 1. Largest time loss on segment 45 St -> 36 St (median +135s vs schedule).
[N] 86% of headway gaps at the target already existed at Prospect Av.

[D] 86% of late trains were already late at Prospect Av (inherited delay). Origins: at or before 50 St: 5, on approach from Prospect Av: 1, at 36 St: 1. Largest time loss on segment 9 Av -> 36 St (median +165s vs schedule).
[R] 57% of late trains were already late leaving Bay Ridge-95 St: crew/rolling-stock availability or terminal dispatch.
[D] 40% of late trains were already late leaving Coney Island-Stillwell Av: crew/rolling-stock availability or terminal dispatch.
46% of hours with problems ran fewer than 90% of scheduled trains (overall service delivered 83%): cancellations or missing trips are creating gaps.
[N] 63% of the run-time loss sits on one segment (45 St -> 36 St, median +135s): a signal timer, speed restriction, or failure on that segment.
[R] Trains that would arrive at 25 St within 180s behind a N/D train lose 48s more there than others (p=0.001; 16% of trips affected); 12% of problem arrivals at the target had such a conflict.
[N] Trains that would arrive at 36 St within 180s behind a R/D train lose 96s more there than others (p=0.003; 30% of trips affected); 28% of problem arrivals at the target had such a conflict.
Weekend problem rate is 2.9x the weekday rate; weekend service changes / planned work likely.
5% of problem arrivals occurred during planned service changes (lift 0.7x).
MTA reports 'Planned ROW Work' as 29% of delays on line(s) R, N, D, W (1.0x the system share) in the analysed months.
ETAs for problem arrivals drifted 332s on average vs 127s otherwise (2.6x): trains are being held or re-dispatched upstream.
11% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'rolling_stock' alert was active for the line (problem rate 32% with an alert vs 18% without, lift 1.8x).
MTA reports 'Infrastructure & Equipment' as 33% of delays on line(s) R, N, D, W (1.0x the system share) in the analysed months.
5% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'police' alert was active for the line (problem rate 32% with an alert vs 18% without, lift 1.8x).
MTA reports 'Police & Medical' as 20% of delays on line(s) R, N, D, W (0.9x the system share) in the analysed months.

recommendations.action: Audit terminal operations at Bay Ridge-95 St during 01:00-02:00, 02:00-03:00, 20:00-21:00, 22:00-23:00: crew reporting, car availability, turnaround time
recommendations.rationale: Trains leave the terminal already late.
recommendations.expected_effect: On-time departures remove the delay at the source.

recommendations.action: Fill cancelled trips on R, N, D, W during 01:00-02:00, 02:00-03:00, 20:00-21:00, 22:00-23:00: check crew availability and car assignments
recommendations.rationale: Fewer trains than scheduled are running in the problem hours.
recommendations.expected_effect: Restores scheduled headways; largest APT lever available.

recommendations.action: Inspect 9 Av -> 36 St for a speed restriction, grade-time signal or signal fault; check recent work orders
recommendations.rationale: Most of the run-time loss sits on one segment.
recommendations.expected_effect: Removing the restriction recovers the segment's excess on every trip.

recommendations.action: Review merge priority and dispatch spacing at 36 St, where R, D trains run ahead of N trains bound for 4 Av-9 St
recommendations.rationale: Arrivals following a train of another route are disproportionately delayed.
recommendations.expected_effect: Fewer merge conflicts; smoother headways for both services.

recommendations.action: Adjust the schedule so R, D and N slots are offset by at least half a headway at 36 St
recommendations.expected_effect: Structural fix that survives day-to-day variability.

sources_used: NY Open Data: trains delayed / incidents
caveats: scheduled counts scaled by observed coverage (1405 polling intervals); hours covered < 50% excluded from service delivered
